_readme: Hero equipment for /coc/tools/equipment, built from the Clash of Clans wiki (Sep 30, 2026). levels[].s holds the stat columns in cols order; ore is [Shiny, Glowy, Starry] to reach that level; bs is the Blacksmith level required. summon: the unit an ability summons -- countCol / levelCol point into cols, and stats hold that unit’s stats by its level. tips are DRAFTS pending review. The ids are the page’s #links (/coc/tools/equipment#fireball).

equipment.name: Barbarian Puppet
equipment.desc: Summons a pack of raged Barbarians
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: Use it when the King runs into an Inferno Tower or a Monolith. The Barbarians soak up damage and help him bring the defense down.
Summoning the Barbarians doesn't make defenses switch targets. Add a Freeze Spell if the King needs to stop taking hits.

summon.note: The Barbarians are the same level as the Barbarians you have researched in the Laboratory.

equipment.name: Vampstache
equipment.desc: Every time the Barbarian King attacks, he heals himself
tips: The King heals on every hit, so he heals the most while hitting high-HP targets like walls and storages.
Anything that keeps damage off him helps it work: Invisibility Spells, the Spirit Fox or the Warden's Eternal Tome.

equipment.name: Earthquake Boots
equipment.desc: Causes a powerful earthquake which destroys Walls and damages Buildings
tips: One stomp breaks walls of any level over a wide area. The same walls would take four Earthquake Spells.
With the Giant Gauntlet, it can open up and wreck a whole compartment of key defenses.
The quake can switch the Town Hall's weapon on early, so be careful using it next to the core.

equipment.name: Rage Vial
equipment.desc: Casts Rage on the Barbarian King
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: The best way to boost the King’s damage and speed: Rage and Haste Spells only work at half strength on him.
Pairs well with Earthquake Boots. Break the walls, then rage through the compartment.

equipment.name: Spiky Ball
equipment.desc: Shoots a Spiky Ball which bounces between buildings
tips: With Earthquake Boots, the quake plus the ball can destroy every building except the Town Hall. Strong against the core.
Pair it with the Rage Vial or Giant Gauntlet to clear a compartment faster.

equipment.name: Giant Gauntlet
equipment.desc: Barbarian King becomes gigantic, doing area damage and taking less damage
tips: Use it next to groups of defenses or swarms of troops. His hits turn into splash damage and he takes less damage.
Pairs with the Rage Vial, Spiky Ball or Earthquake Boots. The Gauntlet lasts 14–19 seconds, longer than the Rage Vial.

equipment.name: Snake Bracelet
equipment.desc: Summons snakes that fight by your side when taking damage
tips: Snakes appear as the King takes damage, so they help most while he is under fire.
Levels 15 and 18 raise the snake limit the most, so they are the levels worth aiming for.

equipment.name: Stick Horse
equipment.desc: Gallop over walls and get increased movement and attack speed after being deployed
tips: A straight upgrade over the Rage Vial: more health, a bigger damage boost, and he gallops over walls right after he is deployed.
With the Giant Gauntlet and an Angry Jelly, he can walk into a compartment and flatten it.

equipment.name: Archer Puppet
equipment.desc: Summons a gang of invisible Archers
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: It doesn't make the Queen invisible. Cover her with a Freeze or Invisibility Spell until the Archers turn visible.
The Archers turn visible before she would with the Invisibility Vial, so they draw fire first.

summon.note: The Archers are the same level as the Archers you have researched in the Laboratory.

equipment.name: Giant Arrow
equipment.desc: Shoots a giant piercing arrow that crosses the entire village
tips: Snipes buildings from across the base. High-HP defenses still need Lightning or Earthquake support.
At a high enough level it one-shots Archer Towers, Cannons, Air Defenses and Air Sweepers.
Useful in ZapQuake attacks, where it saves you a few spells.

equipment.name: Invisibility Vial
equipment.desc: Turns the Queen invisible and gives her stronger attacks
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: Her invisible shots hit very hard. Use it to snipe a key defense or a Clan Castle troop safely.
If she is about to fall with the ability unused, it fires on its own. You can switch that off in the settings.

equipment.name: Healer Puppet
equipment.desc: Summons a flock of Healers
tips: Best in Queen Walks and Queen Charges for extra healing.
Also good after a Recall Spell, or to replace Healers lost to Air Bombs and Air Defenses.

equipment.name: Frozen Arrow
equipment.desc: Icy arrows slow down the targets they hit
tips: Slows whatever she hits, which takes the sting out of single-target Infernos, Monoliths and Scattershots.
The slow is small at low levels, so this one is worth upgrading.

equipment.name: Magic Mirror
equipment.desc: Summons clones of the Archer Queen
tips: Summons clones of the Queen and hides her for a moment, so the clones take the hits from Infernos and Clan Castle troops.
Once the clones fall, defenses turn back to the real Queen.

equipment.name: Action Figure
equipment.desc: Summons Giant Giant to fight by the Archer Queen's side
tips: Summons the Giant Giant, a huge tank. Think of it as a stronger Magic Mirror for funnelling.
Pairs well with the Giant Arrow, Healer Puppet, Archer Puppet and Frozen Arrow.
The Apprentice Warden's HP boost has no cap, so it makes the Giant Giant much harder to kill.

equipment.name: Monolith Arrow
equipment.desc: Monolith Arrow's extra damage decreases when more than 180 and 250 housing spaces of units are deployed
tips: Best against high-HP targets like the Town Hall, defending heroes and walls.
Its extra damage drops once more than 180, then 250, housing space is deployed. Use it early, like in a Queen Walk or Charge.

equipment.name: Eternal Tome
equipment.desc: Grand Warden and all nearby friendly units become immune to damage
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: Use it at the core so the army survives the heaviest damage, or save it for the Town Hall’s blast.
Rage Spells cast during the invincibility get the most out of it.

equipment.name: Rage Gem
equipment.desc: Nearby friendly units do extra damage
tips: Passive, so it boosts every damage dealer near the Warden for the whole attack.
It doesn't add speed, but it does boost Healers' healing. Great in Warden Walks.

equipment.name: Healing Tome
equipment.desc: Heals the Grand Warden and all nearby friendly units
tips: Save it for the core, where the Town Hall's blast and the heaviest defenses hit.
Works best with lots of medium troops: Balloons, Hybrid or Witches.

equipment.name: Life Gem
equipment.desc: Nearby friendly units gain extra hitpoints
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: Best on medium troops like Hog Riders and Miners. Big troops hit the HP cap and small ones don't get the full boost.
For heavy troops, the Apprentice Warden's aura does more, so the Rage Gem is the better pick there.

equipment.name: Fireball
equipment.desc: Throws a giant exploding fireball at the closest defense
tips: It hits the closest defense with splash damage, so it is best when defenses are grouped together.
Pairs well with the Rage Gem.
The target is always the closest defense, which is hard to judge from range. Walk the Warden up to the defense you want hit.

equipment.name: Lavaloon Puppet
equipment.desc: Summons spooky Lavaloons
tips: The Lavaloons tank Air Bombs and Seeking Air Mines for Dragons and Electro Dragons.
The Warden follows the Lavaloons, so deploy your main army first and set him to air mode.

equipment.name: Heroic Torch
equipment.desc: Gives nearby Troops a burning desire to walk through Walls, move faster, and take less damage
tips: Troops near the Warden walk over walls, move faster and take less damage. Great for P.E.K.K.As, Yetis, Electro Titans and Valkyries.
Use it as the push reaches the center to rush through the inner compartments.

equipment.name: Royal Gem
equipment.desc: Heals the Royal Champion by an extra large amount
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: A big heal. Use it when she is low in the middle of the base to get the most out of it.
With the Haste Vial and Invisibility Spells, it makes Royal Charges possible.

equipment.name: Haste Vial
equipment.desc: Casts Haste on the Royal Champion
tips: A big, short damage boost. Use it in the core to take defenses down fast.
Pair it with the Royal Gem so she survives in the center.

equipment.name: Seeking Shield
equipment.desc: Throws her shield which bounces between defenses, dealing damage
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: Bounces between defenses. Use it to knock out key defenses or clean up far-off buildings.
At higher levels it one-shots low-HP defenses. An Air Sweeper needs level 3 or higher.

equipment.name: Hog Rider Doll
equipment.desc: Summons a stampede of Hog Riders
tips: The Hog Riders clear compartments and tank for a solo Royal Champion.
Avoid using it in compartments full of splash defenses or likely traps.

equipment.name: Rocket Spear
equipment.desc: Her next few spear throws are stronger and longer-ranged
tips: Use it right after deploying her to snipe short and medium-range defenses safely.
It can't outrange X-Bows, Mortars, an active Eagle Artillery, the Inferno Artillery or the Monolith.

equipment.name: Electro Boots
equipment.desc: Periodically damages everything around the Royal Champion
tips: Her aura hits ground and air, so it counters swarms of Clan Castle troops like Archers, Witches and Lava Hounds.
It also clears the Skeletons from Skeleton Traps.

equipment.name: Frost Flake
equipment.desc: Flings flakes at the closest Defenses to freeze them
tips: Turns her into support: stay back and freeze a strong compartment of defenses for the army.
Not a great pick for a Royal Charge, since it adds no damage.

equipment.name: Henchmen Puppet
equipment.desc: Summons flying bodyguards to support the Minion Prince
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: The Henchmen tank Seeking Air Mines and Inferno Towers for the Minion Prince, and he turns invisible for a second when they arrive.
Pairs with the Dark Orb: slowed defenses make the Henchmen's tanking last longer.

equipment.name: Dark Orb
equipment.desc: Damages and slows down everything it touches
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: Slows a whole compartment of defenses, so aim it at the core.
Pairs well with the Henchmen Puppet.

equipment.name: Metal Pants
equipment.desc: Creates a protective barrier that blocks almost all damage temporarily
tips: Blocks almost all damage for a few seconds. Good against Seeking Air Mines when he is on his own.
It won't save him from a charged-up single Inferno Tower or a Monolith that has locked on.

equipment.name: Noble Iron
equipment.desc: Increases the speed, range, and power of the Minion Prince's first few attacks
tips: His first attacks get more range, speed and damage. From level 12, only the Inferno Artillery, Firespitters, Long Range Multi-Gear Tower and Longshot outrange him.
Pair it with an Angry Jelly to snipe defenses from far away.

equipment.name: Dark Crown
equipment.desc: Boosts health and damage a total of 3 times when allies are defeated
tips: Gets stronger, up to 3 times, as your units are defeated. It shines late in an attack when the army is thinning.
With the Henchmen Puppet, defeated Henchmen help fill the Crown.

equipment.name: Meteor Staff
equipment.desc: Summons mysterious meteors that repeatedly strike the nearest Defense
tips: Meteors strike the nearest defense from any distance, which helps with cleanup.
Meteors are too brief to trigger Invisibility Spell Towers. Use a Giant Arrow or Spiky Ball for that.

equipment.name: Fire Heart
equipment.desc: Slowly regenerates health and bursts into damaging Flames when Dragon Duke falls
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: Passive: it slowly heals the Duke through the whole attack.
When he falls, he bursts into flames that damage everything around him.

equipment.name: Flame Blower
equipment.desc: Blows scorching fire that damages enemies and buildings
equipment.unlock: Available once the hero is unlocked
tips: Blows fire that damages enemies and buildings in front of him.
With the Rocket Backpack, the flames point the way he flies, so aim the dash at your first targets.

equipment.name: Stun Blaster
equipment.desc: Blasts a shockwave that stuns and damages nearby enemies and buildings.
tips: The shockwave stuns and damages everything nearby. Fire it when he is surrounded by defenses or defending troops.
The stun also buys time for the rest of the army.

equipment.name: Electro Fangs
tips: Chain lightning hits several targets at once, which helps the single-target Duke deal with swarms like Skeleton Traps.

equipment.name: Rocket Backpack
equipment.desc: Dashes across the center of the village breathing Fire and avoiding attacks
tips: He flies across the center breathing fire and dodging attacks.
Aim the dash through an Invisibility Spell Tower to set it off early.

equipment.name: Revenge Deck
equipment.desc: Defenders who strike Dragon Duke are dealt a painful hand
tips: Defenses that hit the Duke take damage back, and he heals with each counter.
It pays off most when he is tanking lots of hits.
